question: What is the meaning of end-of-life management in relation to life cycle information?
description: End-of-life management in relation to life cycle information refers to the documentation and processes involved in sorting, collecting, and treating objects during their end-of-life phase. This includes assessing the environmental and social impact of the product throughout its life cycle, from origin to disposal, and optimizing the design, production, usage, and disposal of products to minimize waste and maximize recycling resources. Access to this information can be facilitated through digital means such as the Web or smart tags like QR codes, enabling product or object identification offline. This approach supports circular economy objectives and ensures supply chain transparency. <|END|>
